title: Make the chat panel draggable and remember its position per manifest
description:
Let the person drag the chat panel to where it is out of the way, and restore that position the next time the same manifest is open.

Requirements:
- Drag by the panel header, without starting a drag from its buttons.
- Provide a keyboard alternative and a way to return to the default position.
- Keep the panel reachable: clamp the saved position to the viewport on restore and on resize, and keep the header on screen.
- Handle compact and expanded chat, which have different sizes. Decide whether they share a position.
- Decide how dragging relates to the existing `chat.side` setting and its switch control, which it may replace.
- Keep the current phone layout, or define what dragging means at that width.
- Multiple devhost instances must not overwrite each other's position.

Storage needs a design decision. `createDevtoolsSettingsStore` keys settings by project root path and page origin, so the same project on two service hostnames has two saved positions, and chat settings can come from a second store when the chat target is devhost. The injected devtools config has `projectRootPath` but no manifest path, so per-manifest storage needs devhost to inject a manifest identity. Position is a page layout setting, so it should not follow the chat target store.

Update the public docs and the demo coverage table for the new behavior.
